diff --git a/index.mjs b/index.mjs
index 4bff70b..49b5415 100644
--- a/index.mjs
+++ b/index.mjs
@@ -1 +1 @@
-export { slugify } from './lib/slug.mjs'
+export { slugify, uniqueSlug } from './lib/slug.mjs'
diff --git a/lib/slug.mjs b/lib/slug.mjs
index 30c170b..1faac76 100644
--- a/lib/slug.mjs
+++ b/lib/slug.mjs
@@ -1,3 +1,19 @@
 export function slugify(input) {
-  throw new Error('slugify is not implemented yet')
+  const normalized = String(input)
+    .normalize('NFD')
+    .replace(/\p{M}/gu, '')
+    .toLowerCase()
+
+  return normalized
+    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')
+    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '')
+}
+
+export function uniqueSlug(base, taken) {
+  const used = new Set(taken)
+  if (!used.has(base)) return base
+
+  let suffix = 2
+  while (used.has(`${base}-${suffix}`)) suffix += 1
+  return `${base}-${suffix}`
 }

artifacts.content:
All 4 tests pass (`# pass 4 / # fail 0`).

**What was missing:** `lib/slug.mjs` had a stub `slugify` that threw, `uniqueSlug` didn't exist at all, and `index.mjs` only re-exported `slugify`.

**Changes:**
- `lib/slug.mjs` — implemented `slugify` (NFD-normalize, strip combining marks via `\p{M}`, lowercase, replace non-alphanumeric runs with `-`, trim leading/trailing dashes) and added `uniqueSlug` (returns the base if free, otherwise the smallest `base-2`, `base-3`, … not in the taken list).
- `index.mjs` — now re-exports both `slugify` and `uniqueSlug`.
